chapter: Rising in Manhattan: clubs, Hilda and the Latin scene
title: Other compositions
summary: Mambo a la Savoy with Walter Fuller and others; he estimates over 150 tunes.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Uh huh. All right. I know that you wrote a lot of tunes there. What was the other tunes that you composed in that apartment, at 111th Street, near Second Avenue?
Ahh, "Mambo a la Savoy" with Walter Fuller. "Yo tengo un ate", "Te lo dije my Friend", "I like the Puerto Rican Way" and -----
About how many tunes have you composed, Macho?
To tell you the truth, I don't know how many, but I know is more than a hundred and fifty.
